_rule: Prepared BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). STAGED, not queued, not authorized. One Water Queens House (S8) launch, Ultra with fg=3, the RTX Hair On bundle of 2026-11-14 (rt_hair_header_cam_gpu=1 inside it), rt_hair_card_fill=1 and rt_hair_dense_sample=1 compiled into the strand pipelines at startup, detailed logging. rt_hair_header_scene_pass (6h) and the fill's header flag are toggled inside the run.

result_hx1_180928.run: captures/queue/logs/hx1-s8-hair-stable.1.180928.log, 12 of 12 phases. INVALID for two job faults, not for the data: the out-fill window (60 frames, 1.7 s) ended before the tenth wheel notch (no wheel-input line of phase 5; the camera did move: 10 trips), and 74 of 600 sample lines carry 'camera step -1.000 m' (no pair after a tag gap), which the pattern's unsigned number refused.
result_hx1_180928.part1_card_fill: HELD. in-fill, watch-fill, out-fill, orbit-r, orbit-l: every switches line has frame watchdog 0, key watchdog 0, coverage low 0; 0 frames with every draw on cards. 3 single-key switches of other causes (in-fill: coverage stale/none/invalidated 1, other 1, on keys first drawn in the window; orbit-l: 1). Trips reported with the fill: in-fill 12 (95 draws under their bound, 17 above), out-fill 10. Fill off (in-off): 6 trips, 10 switches to cards by the frame watchdog, 28 of 61 frames with every draw on cards. Tripped frames kept 55-80% of their card pixels as strands (8 lines, in-fill).
result_hx1_180928.fill_pixels: No counter of filled pixels exists. Dense samples (card-marked pixels): still with the fill 4.1-5.0% 'no strand on the ray' (the card at its own depth: visible) and 8-13% 'outside the card band' (the card behind a strand); moving in-fill 37% and 10% (786 samples, 53% accepted), out-fill 28% and 9% (1055, 63%), in-off without the fill 25% and 16% (1120, 59%); slow orbit 2-9% and 80-86% accepted. Still S/C 0.93-0.95.
result_hx1_180928.cost: strand G-buffer draws 0.299 ms (watch-fill, 4 frames) against 0.394 ms (watch-off, 7 frames); the still windows before spread 0.17-0.29 ms: no cost above the noise (window occluded, few timed frames).
result_hx1_180928.png: frames 2772 (fill) and 3000 (no fill), 1280 px: hair on every head, no hole visible; a seam cannot be judged at that size (the next run dumps the full width in a still window).
result_hx1_180928.part2_remaining_loss: P5 by signature: 'no strand on the ray' in 266 of 600 lines with origin 0.0000 m and 0.000 mrad in all 600, anchors still (median 1.3 mm, p90 5.6 mm), the card 0.14 m from its anchor, 'strand of another draw' 0; where a ray hits, the stored point is under 1 mm off it. The loss follows the camera step times the sine of the pixel's angle from the view axis: accepted 0.79 under 0.1 m, 0.57 at 0.10-0.15 m, 0.29 at 0.15-0.30 m, 0.16 at 0.3-0.5 m, 0 of 11 above 0.5 m. So points, BLAS primitives and rays are right and the boxes the traversal enters are one camera step behind along the view axis: the TLAS traced is the publish before. P1-P4 and P6 excluded (anchors, sine, key age 650-950 frames, no other-draw hits).
result_hx1_180928.cause_6h: The header is applied once per frame label (frame_index + 1) at the first pass with 4 or more colour targets on the G-buffer depth. Two passes of a frame match: the scene G-buffer pass (5 targets, the hair draws) and the decal pass (4, docs/FRAME_MAP.md). When the present that advances frame_index falls between them, the decal pass takes the next label and the next frame's scene pass is skipped: its hair traces the header the decal pass applied (the publish before: TLAS and rows) after its own build refit the BLASes, rewrote the points and copied the camera in place. Checked on the GPU side: the rows each sampled frame read are those of build label - 1 (row order of 11 frames against the '[hair groom] frame' lines), and the build stamp is copied at the apply (the decal pass), so 6e read 'same build'. Second, smaller defect in the same run: tags 2754 and 2757 were each written by two G-buffer frames (two scene passes in one present interval after a hitch; labels 2753 and 2756 have none): the second reuses the first one's sealed entries (hits 0.25-0.57 m behind the card, points 12-161 mm off the ray).

observable: (1) With rt_hair_header_scene_pass=1 no scene G-buffer pass runs on a header the decal pass applied, and the strands stay in every frame of hl1's wheel dolly; (2) without the key, in the same run, the decal pass takes labels during the dolly.
windows: warmup 20 s, warm-off 3 s (fill 0, key 0), warm-on 3 s; pre-in and pre-out (4 s, wheel +10 / -10, unjudged: the near LODs upload); settle-fix, in-fix, out-fix (key 1, fill 0; dolly windows are one stats period of 180 frames, wheel +10 / -10); settle-fill, in-fill, watch-fill (60 frames, PNG at full width), out-fill (key 1, fill 1); orbit-r, orbit-l (key 1, fill 1); settle-off, watch-off (key 1, fill 0, PNG); settle-base, in-base, out-base (key 0, fill 0).

part1_header_pass.key: rt_hair_header_scene_pass (CPU only, live): only the scene G-buffer pass applies the header; a velocity draw recorded after the present still finds its frame's label.
part1_header_pass.predicted_key_on: in-fix, out-fix, in-fill, out-fill, watch-fill, watch-off, orbit-r, orbit-l: the header pass line has 'applied at the scene G-buffer pass N' (N near the window's frames), 'at the decal pass 0', 'label taken by the decal pass 0'. 'by another scene pass' is 0 to 2 per dolly (one per hitch; hx1 180928 had 2 in its first dolly while 6 LODs were decoded; the pre-dolly moves those uploads out of the judged windows).
part1_header_pass.predicted_strands: in-fix, out-fix, in-fill, out-fill: switches line with frame watchdog 0, key watchdog 0, coverage low 0, 0 frames with every draw on cards and 'frame watchdog trips 0' (hx1 180928: 12, 10 and 6 trips in its three dollies). Dense samples, moving side: 'no strand on the ray' falls from 25-37% to the still share (4-5%, at most 9% as in the slow orbit), accepted from 53-63% to 80% or more.
part1_header_pass.predicted_key_off: in-base, out-base: 'label taken by the decal pass' 1 or more (expected: most of the moving frames; in the still windows of 180928 13-19 of 60 frames carried an adjacent tag), frame watchdog trips 5-12 per dolly, 28-frame card periods.
part1_header_pass.if_trips_with_key_on: read the header pass line of that window: 'by another scene pass' above 0 names the hitch frames (two G-buffer frames in one present interval: the second still runs on the first one's header and reuses its entries). That residual needs its own fix (a header per scene pass recording with its own tag). With 'by another scene pass 0' and trips the cause is not the header: read the dense samples of the window.
part1_header_pass.velocity: the publish line's velocity strand draws stay within a few draws of the main G-buffer's with the key on (the velocity gate accepts the label of the interval before); a drop would mean velocity draws recorded after the present are refused.

part2_card_fill.predicted: in-fill, watch-fill, out-fill, orbit-r, orbit-l: 'frame watchdog 0, key watchdog 0, coverage low 0' as in 180928. With the fix the fill has little left to do while moving: the dense samples' 'no strand on the ray' share of in-fill is near watch-fill's.
part2_card_fill.still_image: watch-fill against watch-off (PNG at full width, G-buffer albedo of the scene pass): the 4-5% of card pixels without a strand show the card with the fill and scalp or background without; look for a seam at the hair outline.
part2_card_fill.cost: strand G-buffer GPU ms of watch-fill within the noise of watch-off (180928: 0.30 against 0.39 ms, 4-7 timed frames).

not_gated: the baseline's trips, the dropout counts and the frame watchdog lines are reported; the dense sample lines are 96 per stats period now.
target: the user's target is strands in every frame, also under fast camera motion. The gate of in-fix, out-fix, in-fill and out-fill is that target for the wheel dolly. It can fail on a hitch frame (two G-buffer frames in one present interval), which this change counts but does not fix.
